desc:
🐉 Welcome to Ride a Dragon! 🐉

🎮 How to Play:
🥚 Find eggs on floating islands
🏃 Carry them home before they crack
🐣 Hatch, feed and grow your dragons
🐉 Ride and fly them across the sky
💰 Your dragons earn cash, even offline!

✨ Why you'll love it:
🌙 Eggs hatch 3x faster at night
⛈️ Storms can turn dragons Void, Celestial and more!
🍀 Play with friends: +20% luck for each friend (up to x2!)
🔁 Rebirth for bigger rewards
📖 Collect every dragon in the Index and find hidden secrets

🎟️ Free codes: RELEASE, DRAGONS, ILOVEDRAGONS

👍 Like and ⭐ favorite for new dragons and updates!
🤝 Join the group for a free chest!
